title: skiller host configuration (configs/skiller-host.json)
description: Optional config owned by the host repository that contains a Skiller install. Skiller looks for it at <repo root>/configs/skiller-host.json (or $SKILLER_HOST_CONFIG) relative to its own install, never the target project; without it every host function is off (standalone). Paths are POSIX and relative to the host repo root: no absolute paths, no `..`. Runtime validation is closed and stdlib-only (lib/skiller/host.py); this schema documents the same rules for editor DX.

schema_version.description: Format version of this config; only 1 is accepted.

plugin_dirs.description: Glob patterns of sibling plugin directories (a directory holding .claude-plugin/plugin.json, except Skiller itself) aggregated into the marketplace. Empty or absent: no siblings.

default_command_plugins.description: Plugins enabled by default next to the core plugin on connect/vendor and counted by budget; also the known plugin names. Empty or absent: none.

version_files.description: JSON files whose key is set to the release version (without `v`) by `skiller release`, when the file exists.

key.description: Top-level key that receives the version.

machine_plugins.description: Per machine-level CLI (for example grok): plugins installed from a local directory by install.sh and delivery, then their holds.

name.description: Plugin name as the CLI knows it.

holds.description: Directories installed after the plugin (for example a prefix hold).

runtime_projection_plugins.description: Release units whose codex marketplace runtime readback uses the claude-code projection instead of the runtime projection.

codex_link_roots.description: Extra roots that legacy codex skill links may point into when `skiller update` prunes them.

legacy_runtime_links.description: Historical plugin links in consumer projects that `skiller update` removes when they are symlinks to a known source.

link.description: Link path inside the consumer project.

plugin.description: Plugin name in the provider plugin caches.

source.description: Historical link target inside the host repository.

commands.description: External CLIs Skiller delegates to, by role (permissions, settings_doctor, environment_doctor, trace_doctor, ...). A missing command or binary is a graceful skip.

argv.description: Command line; argv[0] is a host-relative path when it contains `/`, otherwise a name looked up on PATH.

env_override.description: Environment variable whose value replaces argv[0].

install_hint.description: Hint shown in the warning when the binary is missing.

mcp_servers.description: Budget data for MCP servers shipped by the host repository.

tools.description: Number of tools the server exposes.

instructions_tokens.description: Resident server instruction tokens; absent means the budget fallback.

bootstrap.description: Repository bootstrap skills config; absent disables root bootstrap rendering.
